caravan.name: Pella’s Road Caravan
caravan.personality: Pella counts every flask twice and remembers anyone who returns an empty bottle.
caravan.offer: Escort the wagon through the exposed stretch: the party loses a little daylight and 2 HP each, but Pella gives a permanent 5% caravan discount. Once per campaign.

specialist.name: Fen, the Weather Reader
specialist.personality: Fen listens to the ground before setting out a carefully limited kit of supplies.
specialist.offer: Fen sells regional tools, never a guaranteed solution to an undiscovered puzzle.

relic.name: Edda’s Cabinet of Unlikely Things
relic.personality: Edda will exchange a rare trinket for a stable ward fragment and a little honest coin.
relic.offer: Exchange one ward crystal fragment and 30 gold for a Wayfarer’s Boots pair. One exchange per meeting.
